provenance: Root transcription of independent post-hoc review; not blind or authenticated signature
scope: Fixed 36 generic Writer questions across five states; not all 200 generic questions

criteria.P: Current requested answer complete and supported; readable citations (traditional script accepted).
criteria.E: Requested answer complete and supported, plus unnecessary supported details.
criteria.F: Requested answer complete; source recognizable in prose but citation syntax noncanonical.
criteria.A: Correctly expresses evidence insufficiency; unnecessary citation or awkward abstention wording.
criteria.R: Requested content present, but severe repetition/truncation or unsupported extra citations makes full response unsuitable.
criteria.X: Requested content present, but additional unsupported/misattributed claims make full response unsuitable.
criteria.C: Requested factual content present but requested claims have wrong or absent source references.
criteria.M: Missing requested item/insufficiency acknowledgement, or placeholder/no answer.
criteria.W: Wrong requested value, version, scope, unsupported certainty, or false denial of available evidence.
criteria.H: Answers without supplied supporting evidence rather than acknowledging insufficiency.

root_disagreement.reason: Correct formula, but extra B7II belongs to HD10362 and object switch is not identified.
